chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj, who said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the man who plays with his wife during the month of Ramadan until he discharges semen. He (peace be upon him) said: Upon him is the expiation similar to what is upon the one who copulates.
ai.seo_question: What is the expiation for ejaculating during Ramadan through play without full intercourse?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that deliberate sexual play resulting in ejaculation during the day of Ramadan incurs the same expiation as full intercourse, highlighting the juristic principle that the cause of ejaculation is the primary determinant for kaffarah. This ruling underscores the severity of breaking the sanctity of the fasting day through intimate acts, even without full penetration, and aligns with the broader Shia legal emphasis on the spiritual weight of Ramadan observances. The hadith serves as a key reference in usul al-fiqh for distinguishing between minor and major breaches of fasting conditions.
